meta: An air conditioner shows a strange error code? A repair tech can snap a photo and ask AI right at the customer's home, then check the manual and explain the fix simply.

muc.title: An air conditioner error code
muc.text: An air conditioner blinks a strange error code, and the repair tech can take a photo and ask AI right at the customer's home.

muc.title: Look up the code for that exact model
muc.text: Send AI a photo of the error code with the brand and model, and ask it to list the common causes, from easiest to hardest to check.

muc.title: Check against the manual
muc.text: AI can mix up different models, so always check the manufacturer's manual before replacing parts.

muc.title: Explain it to the customer
muc.text: Ask AI to write a simple explanation for the customer: what's broken, why it needs replacing and what it costs, so they understand and trust you.

muc.title: Next time you see a strange code
muc.text: Next time you see an unfamiliar error code, send a photo to a chatbot with the brand and model, then compare its list of causes with the manual.
